newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: WTO chief says to prioritise financial services.
newsitem.headline: WTO chief says to prioritise financial services.

text.p: The World Trade Organisation (WTO) has prioritised the opening of financial services in coming months to lay the foundations for a strong global economy in the 21st century, WTO director-general Renato Ruggiero said on Tuesday.
Ruggiero is in Manila to attend the meeting of the Pacific Basin Economic Council, which has more than 1,200 corporate members from 20 economies.
He told businessmen that the bid to open financial services followed successful negotiations on telecommunications services and information technology.

"Here the stakes are equally great, if not greater; financial services provide the essential means for settling day-to-day transactions of the global economy, and for meeting the financial needs of all economic agents around the world," Ruggiero said.
The WTO has set July 14 as the deadline for receiving offers from various countries, he said. It expects to conclude negotiations on financial services by the end of the year.
